channel.title: ShopNow Labs — new buying guides
channel.description: New question-shaped buying guides from the ShopNow Labs countertop desk.

item.title: Basket or oven-style air fryer: what should you compare?
item.description: The two shapes solve different problems. A practical comparison of dual-basket, single-basket and French-door oven air fryers, using only published specifications.

item.title: A no-hype checklist for comparing air fryer capacity
item.description: Why a 6-quart dual basket is not a 6-quart basket, what capacity numbers actually measure, and the measurements to take before you order.

item.title: How to assess cleanup and counter-space trade-offs
item.description: The two costs nobody puts on a comparison table: the daily washing-up and the permanent square of counter you give up. A practical way to weigh them.

item.title: Questions to ask before buying a multi-function kitchen appliance
item.description: Preset counts are a marketing number. Fourteen questions that separate a multi-function appliance you will use from one that does one thing badly.

item.title: Knowing when food is done: why a probe beats a guess
item.description: Air fryers, ovens and grills all give you time and temperature. None of them tell you the internal temperature of your food. Here is the case for a probe, and what to check before buying one.

item.title: Six things to cook first in a new air fryer
item.description: A starting shortlist for a new basket air fryer: what works immediately, what needs a different technique, and where the capacity you bought starts to matter.
